info.title: rvt-mcp — Revit MCP server (bimwright.dev
info.description: MCP gateway for Autodesk Revit 2022-2027 — expose the Revit API as AI-callable tools with progressive disclosure (toolset gating), a Transaction-safe batch_execute, and a ToolBaker self-evolution engine. Pair with the Revit plugin distributed on GitHub Releases.

options.name: --http
options.description: Run HTTP SSE on 127.0.0.1:<port> (1-65535). Default = stdio.

options.name: --toolsets
options.description: Comma list of toolsets to enable. Default: query,create,view,meta.

options.name: --read-only
options.description: Expose only tools annotated ReadOnly=true (no document/file writes).

options.name: --enable-send-code
options.description: Expose arbitrary C# execution (default ON, independent of ToolBaker).

options.name: --enable-call-log
options.description: Persist tool-call params/results in server and plugin logs (default OFF).

options.name: --disable-call-log
options.description: Suppress call logs, including the send_code body journal.

options.name: --max-response-bytes
options.description: Default 1048576; remains active with guard OFF.

options.name: --spill-retention-hours
options.description: Hours a spill file is kept before cleanup (1-8760).

options.name: --allow-lan-bind
